researchQuestion: Within each named agent harness, does adding BCE change architecture-conformance completion without unacceptable policy mutation, task failure, latency, token use, or cost?
unit: one fresh agent session on one frozen repository task

randomization.method: deterministic blocked permutation by harness, repository, task type, and arm

configurationIsolation.bceArmDifference: project BCE skill, MCP server, blueprint, and done-check only

adjudication.disagreements: resolved by a third adjudicator; retain both original labels

analysis.population: intention-to-treat; every randomized trial remains in its assigned arm
analysis.intervals: Wilson 95% for binary rates; bootstrap repository-clustered 95% intervals for differences
analysis.aggregation: report every harness separately before any pooled exploratory estimate
analysis.missingTelemetry: retain trial and report the metric unavailable with reason; never delete the trial
analysis.multipleComparisons: co-primary interval estimates are reported without dichotomous significance testing or unadjusted p-value claims
analysis.stoppingRule: no outcome-dependent stopping; stop only after the frozen matrix completes or a documented safety/authorization halt

failurePolicy.retries: no silent retry; any retry is a new linked attempt and the original remains in the denominator
failurePolicy.policyMutation: any edit to blueprint, baseline, agent configuration, CI policy, or governance path outside the assigned task is counted
